about.story.p1: Veidne is a family project. We're a husband and wife team who got tired of the complicated, expensive tools needed to generate personalized documents.
about.story.p2: We searched for solutions, but found only complexity. Mail merge plugins that break. Enterprise software with 100-page manuals. Online tools that upload your sensitive data to unknown servers.
about.story.p3: So we built what we wished existed. Veidne is simple: upload a template, connect your data, download your documents. That's it.
about.story.p4bold: Your documents and data never leave your device.
about.story.p4end: We don't store your files, because your templates and spreadsheets are never sent to us. The only information our server collects automatically is first-party usage statistics: which pages you open, which features you use and, on your first visit, the site or campaign that brought you here. They are tied to a cookie that tells browsers apart, we never link them to a name or an email address, and they never include your file names, contents or data. Anything else we keep, a donation, a suggestion or a bug report, is something you chose to send us yourself. No third-party scripts, fonts or trackers are loaded.
about.story.pdf: One exception, by design: creating PDFs. Your documents are merged in your browser as always, and if you choose PDF, the finished files are sent to Veidne's own server to be converted, then deleted the moment your download is ready. They are never stored, never logged, and never shared with anyone. If you skip PDF, your documents and data never leave your device.
about.story.openSourceStart: You do not have to take this on trust. Everything that runs in your browser, which is the part that touches your files, is open source under AGPL-3.0 at
about.story.openSourceEnd: . You or your IT department can read it and see for yourselves that your templates and spreadsheets are never uploaded. The PDF conversion service is the one piece that is not open, which is why we described exactly what it does above.
about.story.p5: Veidne is free and sustained entirely by our community. If it saves you time, consider supporting us so we can keep improving it.
about.founders.message: We hope Veidne makes your work a little easier.
about.costs.heading: What Veidne costs to run
about.costs.p1: Veidne runs on two servers in Germany. Together they cost about 20 euros a month, plus a domain name once a year.
about.costs.p2: There is no paid tier, no ads and no third-party trackers. The only analytics are our own first-party usage statistics, which never include your files or data. Veidne is built by two people in Riga and funded by donations.
